ASS00647 is a specific laboratory test code used within the Danish healthcare system to measure [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1] [^src2]. It serves as a critical data point in national clinical quality registries, specifically for monitoring the diagnostic and treatment pathways of patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1] [^src2]. 

In the context of the "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute, ASS00647 is explicitly listed among the approved laboratory codes that qualify as a performed TSH measurement [^src1] [^src2]. Specifically, it is utilized to calculate the metrics for the clinical quality indicator dedicated to "TSH måling" (TSH measurement), which is identified as indicator 3 in the national guidelines [^src1]. By tracking whether patients receive this specific thyroid function test, healthcare authorities can evaluate adherence to evidence-based clinical standards and ensure comprehensive diagnostic workups for atrial fibrillation patients [^src2].

The code appears in technical guidelines detailing the calculation rules, inclusion criteria, and specific code sets required for register-based analyses [^src1] [^src2]. It is consistently grouped with other laboratory identifiers (such as NPU27547 and DNK35895) across different annual iterations of the national quality reports, highlighting its standardized role in health data infrastructure [^src1] [^src2].
